name: Shimai x Choukyou ~Zettai Fukujuu, Celeb Shimai to Mainichi Nakadashi Seikatsu~
original_name: 姉妹X調教～絶対服従、セレブ姉妹と毎日中出し性活～
source:
The protagonist Shitara Naoki, is fired from his job managing the parking lot of a university, and becomes desperate albeit partially. The reason is because of his attitude at work, however, it does not matter to him who has lived with a self-centered personality for over 40 years, regardless, he blames his surroundings and drowns himself in alcohol to escape from anxiety.

One day, he gets into a fight with another customer at a bar and is forced to leave. While grumbling and going home, because of his drunkenness, his legs get tangled up which make him leap onto the road, and gets hit by an oncoming car. A woman comes out of the car and takes out her phone, while seeing her calling someone, Naoki faints.

When he wakes up, he sees two women. Apparently, they are the ones who run him over. Furthermore, he learns that due to some circumstances, the accident cannot be revealed to the public.

"How selfish of them...... In this case, let's be selfish towards them as well!"

Taking advantage of these two women, Naoki begins to pay them back.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1237580]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公直木志乐因管理大学停车场而被解雇，陷入了绝望。原因在于他的工作态度，然而，对于四十多年来以自我为中心的性格生活的他来说，这并不重要，他仍然怨天尤人，通过酗酒来逃避焦虑。

有一天，他在酒吧与另一位顾客打架，被迫离开。一边抱怨着回家，一边喝醉了酒，双腿缠住，他跳到马路上，被迎面驶来的汽车撞了。一名女子从车里走出来，拿出手机，看到她打电话给别人，直树晕了过去。

当他醒来时，他看到了两个女人。显然，他们就是碾压他的人。此外，他得知由于某些情况，事故无法向公众透露。

“他们真是自私啊……既然如此，那我们也自私一点吧！”

利用这两个女人的优势，直树开始报复她们。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1237580]Getchu[/url]]
